objective: limit losing momentum entries without extending parent H12 or cutting native original big winners based on future outcome
single_changed_axis: early-exit intent on two consecutive completed adverse 4h closes

parent.entry_rule: abs(ret1) >= 1.5 * retstd20 and ret1 > 0 and ema20 > ema50
parent.hold: original 12 completed 4h bars / exit at original H12 scheduled close
parent.native_features: pin original f020/50 ret std code, 240 bar warmup

candidate.condition: at end of consecutive holdings bars j-1 and j: both CLOSE < entry_open AND both CLOSE < native 4h EMA20; j CLOSE < (j-1) CLOSE
candidate.action: exit at earliest next bar open j+1 only in modelled development; parent original H12 close remains default otherwise
candidate.latency_stress: add optional one extra fully closed 4h bar before modeled fill; diagnostic only, not candidate tuning

acceptance: Development signal only if Net2 improves, Net2 > 0, PF2>1, net2 winner capture preserved, DD/streak no material regression, model latency stress acceptable. Otherwise REJECT/route_change; never economic/G5 PASS.
